build: lean and defined from studio pilates, collarbones sharp
hair: dark brown, natural texture worn in a high puff or loose braids that she fidgets with when thinking; sometimes wrapped in silk at night
complexion: deep warm brown with golden undertones; a small crescent scar above her left hip from a childhood fall
face: heart-shaped with a wide, expressive mouth and eyes that telegraph every thought before her brain catches up—the face of someone still learning to guard herself
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, always moving, stained with ink or paint or clay dust; the way she gestures when she talks makes even silence feel inhabited
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, which deepens when she swallows hard or breathes shallow—a tell he will learn to read
signature_habits: she hums Fela Kuti when concentrating, a habit from her grandmother's kitchen; she takes her coffee black and too hot, burning her mouth; she texts in fragments, never full sentences; she touches her collarbone when she's lying or afraid; she keeps a small bottle of shea butter in her bag and rubs it into her elbows absently
occupation: textile artist and owner of a small studio in Brooklyn where she designs and hand-dyes fabrics for independent fashion designers and interior clients—three employees, a waiting list, no corporate backing

current_crisis.event: her studio's landlord—a developer with billionaire backing—has just served a 60-day eviction notice; the building is being demolished for luxury condos; she has no capital reserves and no legal recourse
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with a sick, creeping shame that she's failed
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find $40,000 in rent deposits and moving costs without admitting to anyone that she's drowning

wound.core: she believes that needing help is a sign she's not enough—that self-sufficiency is the only proof of her worth
wound.surfacing_hint: when cornered, she becomes very still and very quiet; her eyes go flat; she agrees to things she doesn't want, then spirals alone
